title: GAME CONCEPT ART
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Game Concept Art - Associate of Arts Degree and Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Articulate visual direction of various game-targeted assets through concept ideation and rendering.
Apply the principles of modern game development through the creation of creative assets and supporting materials.
Contribute to working games and prototypes require team management, effective planning, communication, time management, and responsiveness.
Develop and integrate content that contributes and adds value to games projects or portfolio.
Create modern portfolio demonstrating viable capability utilizing games and class projects.

notes: The page prints one combined section for the degree and the Certificate of Achievement; the certificate shares the single 27-unit course requirements list and the single Program Learning Outcomes list printed for the program as a whole.
Codes are printed with a hyphen (e.g., GAM-5B); these match closed-list codes (GAM 5B etc.) and are not treated as catalog additions.

Heading inconsistency: the page titles list both 'Associate of Science Degree' and 'Associate of Arts Degree' versions, and the closing paragraph refers to an Associate of Science Degree; reviewer may want to confirm the degree type, though the certificate requirements are unaffected.
The outcome 'Contribute to working games and prototypes require team management...' is copied as printed, including its grammar.
